key: series:1/series_description
    // Please describe the experimental series - what is done, with what aim, and where its record comes from (leave empty to skip)?
    // source: X: ELN Chemotion LCJ-R5 and LCJ-R8, names, descriptions, conditions and the segment 'Reaction Details' (written by Claude Code, 05.10.2026)
Reductive catalytic fractionation (RCF) of spruce wood (Picea abies): wood, a 5 wt% Pd/C catalyst and methanol in a stainless steel autoclave under 50 bar hydrogen at 151 °C for 3 h; the lignin goes into the methanol as a phenolic oil (mainly 4-propylguaiacol), the cellulose stays behind as a solid pulp. Two runs on two batches of wood - the reactions LCJ-R5 and LCJ-R8 of Congjian Lin's Chemotion collection 'Experiment', given as an example of a Chemotion export.
